briefdescription.para: A map to keep track of local memory objects and their offsets within the local memory space.

detaileddescription.para: This field is only used in the instruction selector and not part of the machine function info.

briefdescription.para: Align for dynamic shared memory if any.

detaileddescription.para: Dynamic shared memory is allocated directly after the static one, i.e., LDSSize. Need to pad LDSSize to ensure that dynamic one is aligned accordingly. The maximal alignment is updated during IR translation or lowering stages.
